storyline.headline: North Carolina Receives Additional $28 Million for Disaster Recovery
storyline.summary: The US government has approved an additional $28 million in reimbursement funds to support North Carolina's recovery from Tropical Storm Helene and other disasters, bringing the total to $124 million in August alone. This funding is part of the $656 million provided to the state for road repair, debris removal, and critical infrastructure repair since the disasters occurred.

storyline.headline: Kentucky Counties Eligible for FEMA Public Assistance After Flooding and Tornadoes
storyline.summary: Kentucky counties affected by April flooding and May tornadoes are now eligible for FEMA Public Assistance, which provides federal grants for debris removal, emergency protective work, and repair or replacement of public infrastructure.
